Adjusted net loss is defined as net loss before stock-based compensation, other (expense) income, net, (gain) loss on convertible notes, net, and the donation to Forever by Rivian, Inc. Adjusted net loss per share is defined as adjusted net loss divided by the weighted-average common shares outstanding. Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net loss before interest expense (income), net, provision for income taxes, depreciation and amortization, stock-based compensation, other (expense) income, net, (gain) loss on convertible notes, net, and the donation to Forever by Rivian, Inc.
